notes: Single-stage: implement a fixed-semantics integer MLP (nn.py), a self-test entry that constructs the model and performs real forward passes against known-answer probes (selftest.py, printing SELFTEST_OK and exposing run_selftest -> bool with no broad exception swallowing), and a batch predict CLI. The verifier executes the self-test against fresh valid weight sets (different dims) and corrupted weight sets (shifted weight, shifted bias, missing key) where faking success or swallowing failures is caught behaviourally, plus an AST check for bare/broad excepts. Rubric nonzero for adversarial_inputs and hidden_case_generalization (corrupted vs valid hidden sets), reasoning_depth (fixed arithmetic + tie-breaking + failure-path design), dependent_stages (selftest depends on nn.py), quantitative_correctness (exact logits/labels).
